name: AI Academy Asia
mission: To help students, adults, and companies learn practical AI skills through project-based learning.

programs.name: Become a Globally Competitive AI Engineer
programs.focus: AI tools, automation, real-world AI projects

programs.name: Turn Your Ideas Into Real Projects With AI
programs.focus: Building real projects with AI tools

programs.name: Prepare for Top Universities With AI
programs.focus: Using AI to prepare for top university applications

faq.question: Do students need prior AI or programming knowledge?
faq.answer: Many programs are designed for beginners and teach AI or programming fundamentals from scratch.

faq.question: Do students receive a certificate?
faq.answer: Students can receive a CPD accredited certificate upon successful completion.

faq.question: Are there online classes?
faq.answer: Some programs are online, such as the Real Projects With AI program. Other programs may be in-person.

faq.question: Who are the programs for?
faq.answer: AI Academy Asia offers programs for kids/juniors, adults, and companies.

currency_note: Some program prices are listed in USD at the day's exchange rate; some are listed in MNT.
